s04.c1.en: Let's slow it right down, and paint one spoke yellow.

s04.c2.en: A small turn between pictures: it looks like it turns forwards. Correct!

s04.c3.en: Now it turns almost one spoke gap between pictures.

s04.c4.en: Every spoke lands just short of where the next one was...

s04.c5.en: ...so the closest match is backwards. The wheel seems to turn backwards!

s04.c6.en: Turn exactly one gap per picture, and every picture looks the same.

s04.c7.en: The wheel seems frozen, even though it is spinning fast.
